# Task 058 shared bounded-ASCII String conformance corpus.
#
# ONE corpus drives the generated Rust, C++ and Ada validators of every
# representative carrier in
# crates/xsd-frontend/tests/fixtures/backend-string-bounded-ascii.xsd (one per
# admitted alphabet). Expectations were derived from the alphabet member sets
# and length facets alone, independently of every backend.
#
# FORMAT
#   CARRIER <Name>                  the following cases target this carrier
#   VALID <input> => <stored>       stored is always the input unchanged
#   INVALID <input>
# Escapes: \s space  \t tab  \n LF  \r CR  \\ backslash  \u{HEX} any code
# point; <empty> is the empty string.
#
# COVERAGE PER CARRIER
#   minimum and maximum length; one below the minimum; one above the maximum;
#   both endpoints and a midpoint of every admitted range; every admitted
#   punctuation / SPACE character; the forbidden ASCII neighbour on each side
#   of every range; TAB, LF, CR, DEL, NUL; non-ASCII (U+00A0, U+00E9, U+20AC,
#   U+1F600); leading, trailing and all-SPACE values where SPACE is admitted;
#   the lower-case twin where only upper case is admitted.
#
# whiteSpace = preserve: nothing is trimmed or folded, so each VALID case
# stores its input unchanged and SPACE is valid only where it is a member.

CARRIER Blank
VALID <empty> => <empty>
INVALID A
INVALID \s
INVALID \s\s
INVALID \t
INVALID \n
INVALID \r
INVALID \u{7F}
INVALID \u{0}
INVALID \u{A0}
INVALID \u{E9}
INVALID \u{20AC}
INVALID \u{1F600}
